item.text:
**4B.7 — Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**  
**Assessment:** mixed, leaning negative. AMLO’s government did take real formal steps for Indigenous/Afromexican rights, anti-discrimination, migrant children, and women’s protection, but the lived record still shows heavy exclusion, discriminatory policing, and weak protection for migrants, Indigenous/Afro-Mexican people, protesters, journalists, and other unpopular groups.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| + | [Reforma en materia de pueblos indígenas y afromexicanos es un acto de justicia social](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/reforma-en-materia-de-pueblos-indigenas-y-afromexicanos-es-un-acto-de-justicia-social/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-02-21 | The executive-backed reform said Indigenous and Afro-Mexican peoples would be recognized as subjects of public rights, with self-determination, direct budget authority, consultation rights, and explicit protections for women and migrant Indigenous communities. | 4B.7, 4B.4 |
| + | [Gobierno de México instala Mecanismo para la Implementación y Protección de los Derechos de los Pueblos Indígenas](https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/gobierno-de-mexico-instala-mecanismo-para-la-implementacion-y-proteccion-de-los-derechos-de-los-pueblos-indigenas-385941?idiom=fr) | Secretaría de Gobernación | 2024-12-11 | The outgoing administration installed a cross-agency mechanism, including INE, IFT, CONAPRED, CNDH, and congressional committees, to implement and protect Indigenous rights. | 4B.7, 4B.4 |
| + | [Programa Nacional para la Igualdad y No Discriminación](https://www.conapred.gob.mx/publicacion/166) | CONAPRED | 2024 | CONAPRED said the federal anti-discrimination program was meant to prevent and combat structural discrimination against historically discriminated groups under a “no dejar a nadie atrás” frame. | 4B.7 |
| + | [Anuncia DIF Nacional acciones de protección a niñez migrante](https://www.gob.mx/difnacional/articulos/anuncia-dif-nacional-acciones-de-proteccion-a-ninez-migrante) | Sistema Nacional DIF | 2024-06-17 | DIF said 88 active centers were operating for migrant children and families, showing a concrete protection effort for a highly vulnerable excluded group. | 4B.7 |
| + | [Se refuerza estrategia contra la violencia hacia las mujeres y niñas](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/se-refuerza-estrategia-contra-la-violencia-hacia-las-mujeres-y-ninas-sspc) | SSPC | 2024-08-06 | The government claimed a reinforced anti-violence strategy for women and girls, with outreach, public-servant/police training, and a reported drop in feminicide versus 2018. | 4B.7 |
| + | [Mexican government offers public apology to families of missing girls and women and femicide victims in Ciudad Juárez](https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/mexican-government-offers-public-apology-to-families-of-missing-girls-and-women-and-femicide-victims-in-ciudad-juarez?idiom=en) | SRE | 2024-03-06 | The state formally apologized for long-running failures in a gender-violence case, which is a limited accountability signal for women and girls. | 4B.7 |
| + | [20-05-24 version estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-05-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-05-20 | AMLO said conservatives were “adversaries, not enemies” and that repression, authoritarianism, and censorship were unnecessary, a weak but real rhetorical signal for pluralism and unpopular viewpoints. | 4B.7, 4B.5, 4B.6 |
| - | [Ninguna forma de discriminación racial debe existir](https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/ninguna-forma-de-discriminacion-racial-debe-existir?idiom=en) | Secretaría de Gobernación / CONAPRED | 2024-03-21 | The government itself acknowledged persistent barriers such as lack of interpreters, racial profiling, arbitrary detentions, invisibility of Afro-Mexicans, and obstacles to identity documents for Indigenous, migrant, and ethnic-minority people. | 4B.7, 4B.5 |
| - | [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | HRW said migrants are preyed upon, checkpoints disproportionately affect Indigenous and Afro-Mexican people, women with disabilities face disproportionate violence, and Mexico made little progress on gender violence and attacks on defenders. | 4B.7, 4B.4 |
| - | [Mexico: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House said protests were frequent but police often used excessive force and arbitrary detention, with Indigenous groups and women protesters especially vulnerable. | 4B.7, 4B.5 |
| - | [Mexico City police arrest 2 journalists at human rights protest](https://cpj.org/2024/09/mexico-city-police-arrest-2-journalists-at-human-rights-protest/) | Committee to Protect Journalists | 2024-09-09 | Police beat and arrested journalists during a protest that included Otomí Indigenous participants, showing unequal treatment of protest and dissent in practice. | 4B.7, 4B.5, 4B.6 |

**Search gap:** direct evidence on “opposition regions” is thin. The strongest 2024 material I found is about Indigenous/Afro-Mexican equality, migrants, women, protesters, and journalists, not region-specific equality policy.
